summary: 온순하고 사람을 잘 따르며 사냥 본능이 강한 명랑한 가족견.
description: There are two Beagle varieties: those standing under 13 inches at the shoulder, and those between 13 and 15 inches. Responsible breeders will screen their breeding stock for health conditions such as hip dysplasia, hypothyroidism, epilepsy, luxating patella (a dislocated kneecap), and eye disorders. Beagles are active, energetic dogs who need at least an hour of exercise every day. As with all dogs, early socialization and puppy training classes are a must. The Beagle has a smooth, dense double coat that gets heavier in the winter, so spring is shedding season.

description: Basenjis are small, graceful hounds standing 16 or 17 inches at the shoulder. Basenji are generally healthy dogs, and responsible breeders screen for health disorders such as hypothyroidism, a type of inflammatory bowel disease called IPSID and canine hip dysplasia. Basenjis are energetic, inquisitive, and very active. Early socialization and puppy training classes are recommended for all breeds, but given the Basenji's bountiful energy, intelligence, and penchant for mischief, they are a necessity. Basenjis are fastidious creatures.

description: Poodles come in three size varieties: Standards should be more than 15 inches tall at the shoulder; Miniatures are 15 inches or under; Toys stand no more than 10 inches. Most Toy Poodles live long, happy, healthy lives thanks to the efforts of dedicated, responsible breeders who routinely test all breeding stock.
